lines.en: (Wedding in Debar)
In Debar above Broshtica
the zurla sounds for a big wedding.
Beautiful Fatima is married out,
beautiful Fatima, to Mehmed.
Beautiful Fatima, follow the custom.

lines.cyr: да го видиш зетот низ прстенот,
lines.lat: da go vidiš zetot niz prstenot,
lines.en: Look at Mehmed through your ring,
so you will carry him in your heart.

lines.cyr: А ти Мехмеде, азган момче бре,
lines.lat: A ti Mehmede, azgan momče bre,
lines.en: But you, Mehmed, you wild boy, eh,

lines.cyr: на коњ да ја качиш невестата,
lines.lat: na konj da ja kačiš nevestata,
lines.en: lift the bride up on your horse

lines.cyr: да ја носиш в' таткова куќа.
lines.lat: da ja nosiš v' tatkova kuḱa.
lines.en: and carry her to your father’s house.
Play loudly, you Majovci musicians,
come on, dance, Macedonians,
so that is known in the distance
how important the truth is.
Beautiful Fatima, follow the custom.

lines.cyr: да го видиш зетот низ прстенот,
lines.lat: da go vidiš zetot niz prstenot,
lines.en: Look at Mehmed through your ring,
so you will carry him in your heart.

lines.lat: A ti Mehmede, azgan momče bre,
lines.en: But you, Mehmed, you wild boy, eh,

lines.en: lift the bride up on your horse

lines.cyr: да ја носиш в' таткова куќа.

lines.en: and carry her to your father’s house.
Our wedding, our wedding of Broshtica.
